pathAssistantSteps.info:
Activated - service is live.

  • Asset record created in Odoo and synced back via IP-2
  • Contract linked to Order
  • Billing cycle begins on Effective Date

Draft - Order created from signed SOF.

  • Verify BAN is assigned and Finance-approved
  • Confirm Space ID and Breaker Panel ID are set on all line items
  • Run Confirm Order to validate all 12 gate checks
